Package com.rpglab.game.characters

Class Hero

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.rpglab.game.characters.Character
      • com.rpglab.game.characters.Hero
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Combatente
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    Archer, Mage
    public abstract class Hero
extends Character
    Abstract base class for all hero characters in the Dungeon Adventure RPG. Heroes are player-controlled characters that can level up, gain experience, and have special abilities. They extend the basic Character functionality with progression systems and luck mechanics.

    Heroes have additional attributes like level, experience points, and luck values that affect their performance in combat and interactions. They can equip weapons with level restrictions and use special skills unique to their class.

    Since:

      • gainExperience

        public void gainExperience​(int exp)
        Awards experience points to the hero and handles automatic leveling. Heroes level up automatically when they reach 100 experience points. Excess experience carries over to the next level.
        Parameters:
